images.after: What Pinterest's rules say about affiliate links
images.title: Pinterest's conditions for affiliate links
images.alt: Checklist of Pinterest's affiliate link conditions: disclose, keep content original, use links in moderation, one real account, and care with shorteners.
images.caption: Affiliate links are allowed on Pinterest, but only when these conditions are met.

items: Be transparent about commercial content and your links
Keep affiliate content original and adding unique value
Use affiliate links in moderation, not in large volumes
Use one real account, with no fake or traded saves
Be careful with link shorteners and redirects
Follow the FTC's disclosure rules as well in the US

images.note: Check Pinterest's guidelines page for the current wording

images.after: Pin straight to an affiliate link, or to your own article?
images.title: Where should this Pin point?
images.alt: Decision chart: a single product needing little explanation in a program that permits it can get a direct Pin; otherwise pin to your own article.
images.caption: Both are allowed, but a Pin to your own page keeps working when a program changes its terms.

data.question: One product, little explanation needed, and the program clearly permits it?

branches.result: A direct affiliate Pin can work, with disclosure. Keep these a small share.
Pin to your own article and put the affiliate links on that page.

images.after: Using keywords in Pin titles, descriptions and boards
images.title: Where keywords go on Pinterest
images.alt: Four cards on Pinterest keywords: search phrase first in titles, plain sentences in descriptions, specific board names, and phrases from Pinterest search.
images.caption: Text helps people discover your Pins, so put the phrase someone would search where it shows.

items.title: Pin title
items.text: Up to 100 characters. Put the search phrase at the front.

items.title: Description
items.text: Up to 800 characters. Two or three ordinary sentences, not a keyword list.

items.title: Boards
items.text: Specific board names that match your main article categories.

items.title: Where phrases come from
items.text: Pinterest's search bar and Pinterest Trends, not your Google keyword list.
